dash.title: Admin dashboard
dash.lead_admin: Every number comes from what learners actually did. Every average shows how many ratings stand behind it.
dash.lead_teacher: Here you can review and edit questions.
dash.active: Active in the last 7 days (answered at least once)

pilot.title: Pilot results
pilot.note: Target from the final deck: clarity and helpfulness average at least 4 out of 5. For pressure, lower is better.
pilot.accepted: Rated proposals the learner accepted at least in part
pilot.return: Learners who came back after an interruption (resumed / all)

subs.title: Learner subscriptions
subs.billing_off: Billing is off (free pilot), so these counts are for information only.

q.title: Questions
q.banner_on: In production only approved questions reach learners. Right now the setting allow_unreviewed_questions is ON, so questions waiting for review are shown too. Questions that need editing are never shown.
q.banner_off: Only approved questions reach learners (allow_unreviewed_questions is OFF). Questions waiting for review or needing edits are not shown.
q.import_help: Upload a JSON file shaped like the export (at most 1 MB and 500 questions). New ids are added as waiting for review. Ids that already exist are skipped, never overwritten.
q.fix_errors: Some fields need your attention. Nothing was saved.
q.reset_hint: If you change the question, answers or explanations of an approved question, it goes back to waiting for review.

form.options_hint: Exactly four different answers. Tick the correct one.
form.topic_hint: For example a grammar point such as 了. Optional.

err.invalid_type: This value has the wrong type.
err.options_count: There must be exactly four options.
err.options_distinct: The four options must all be different.
err.invalid_choice: This is not an allowed value.
err.invalid_number: This number is out of range.
err.bad_id: The id is missing or not valid.
err.not_object: This item is not a question object.

import.title: Import result
import.note: Added questions are waiting for review. Nothing that already existed was changed.
import.invalid_title: Why some items were not imported

fatal.too_large: The file is larger than 1 MB. Nothing was imported.
fatal.bad_json: The file is not valid JSON. Nothing was imported.
fatal.bad_format: The file must contain a list of questions. Nothing was imported.
fatal.too_many: The file has more than 500 questions. Nothing was imported.

user.privacy_note: Learners' own words, passwords and sessions are never shown here. Only the reason for an interruption and its status are visible.
user.activate_title: Activate a plan after a bank transfer
user.activate_help: Records the payment and extends access from the current end date.
user.amount_hint: Leave empty to use the plan price.
user.no_active_plans: There is no active plan. Add one under Plans and payments.
user.role_self: You cannot change your own role.
user.sessions_help: Logs this account out on every device. The learner can log in again.
user.interruptions_note: Only the reason and the status are shown, never what the learner wrote.
user.placement_help: Use this when a learner was parked at A1 while no question was approved yet. It clears their current level and completion so they can take the check again.

billing.title: Plans and payments
billing.off_note: Billing is off, so everyone studies for free during the pilot. You can still prepare plans here.
billing.code_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. It cannot be changed later.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: Everything done in the admin area, newest first.

flash.question_saved_review: Saved. Because the content changed, the question is waiting for review again.
flash.question_created: Question {id} created. It is waiting for review.
flash.activated: Plan activated. Access now lasts until {until}.
flash.err_invalid_days: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 365.
flash.err_not_learner: This only works for learner accounts.
flash.err_invalid_amount: The amount must be a whole number from 0 to 1,000,000.
flash.err_unknown_plan: That plan does not exist or is not open.
flash.err_own_role: You cannot change your own role.
flash.err_last_admin: You cannot remove the last admin.
flash.err_plan_code: The code needs lowercase letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter.
flash.err_plan_invalid: Check the plan: names up to 60 characters, a price from 0 to 1,000,000 and 1 to 3650 days.
flash.err_plan_exists: A plan with this code already exists.
flash.err_duplicate: The same action was just recorded in the last minute. Nothing was added, to avoid charging twice.
flash.placement_reset: The learner can now retake the placement check.
